author_or_institution: Joel Becker; Nate Rush; Tom Cunningham; David Rein; Khalid Mahamud / METR
title: We are Changing our Developer Productivity Experiment Design
book_use: Documents selection and measurement problems in METR's late-2025 follow-up study, including developers declining no-AI conditions and concurrent agent use; METR says early-2026 tools likely provide more speedup than early-2025 tools but treats the available follow-up data as weak evidence for the magnitude.
